senses.gloss: ch. same, patch; trnsf. (cmp. נָאָתָא) cicatrix, scab; ר׳ דכוסילתא the scab or scar over the puncture made by bleeding, v. כּוֹסִילְתָּא; also the puncture.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 93b">Snh. 93ᵇ</cite> <he>אפי׳ כר׳ דכ׳ וכ׳</he> no imperfection, even so much as the mark of bleeding, was on their bodies.
<cite ref="Ketubot 39b:3">Keth. 39ᵇ</cite> (Var. in Rashi a. Ar. <he>תרפתא דסיבורי</he> or <he>דסיכורי</he>), v. <cite ref="K00325"><he>כּוֹסִילְתָּא</he></cite>.
